candidate_sentence_map.S1: Nordic Fibreboard AS reported unaudited consolidated revenue of €1.861 million for Q1 2026, up 7.3% from €1.735 million in Q1 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The increase was mainly driven by Finnish DIY stores, where order volume rose by €241 thousand to €855 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: European Union sales increased to €1.781 million from €1.639 million, while sales to Africa declined to €62 thousand from €87 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Despite the revenue growth, profitability deteriorated substantially.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: EBITDA was negative €395 thousand compared with negative €85 thousand a year earlier, reducing the EBITDA margin to negative 21% from negative 5%.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The Group reported an operating loss of €530 thousand, versus €217 thousand in Q1 2025, and a net loss of €570 thousand compared with €228 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Basic and diluted earnings per share were both negative €0.07 for the quarter, compared with negative €0.05 in Q1 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The main pressure came from production costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Cost of goods sold increased to €1.966 million from €1.608 million, turning gross profit of €127 thousand into a gross loss of €105 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Electricity, heat and water costs rose to €1.048 million from €725 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The Group states that results were negatively affected by the scheduled factory shutdown in early January during the transition to a new boiler house.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Commissioning, calibration and start-up of the new system took approximately two months, while cold weather increased normal energy consumption.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: In late February, the US military attack on Iran caused gas prices to nearly double; although prices subsequently declined, they remained approximately 50% above the beginning-of-year level.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Distribution costs increased to €261 thousand from €228 thousand and administrative expenses to €154 thousand from €111 thousand, partly offset by lower total labour costs of €411 thousand versus €471 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Financial expenses declined to €41 thousand from €51 thousand, but Q1 2025 included €40 thousand of financial income from the sale of Trigon Property Development shares, which did not recur.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: At 31 March 2026, total assets were €9.694 million, up from €8.722 million a year earlier, while total liabilities increased to €5.802 million from €5.334 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Equity fell from €4.462 million at 31 December 2025 to €3.892 million after the quarterly loss, and the debt-to-equity ratio rose to 60% from 52%.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Operating cash flow improved to €13 thousand from negative €528 thousand, but €169 thousand was invested in production assets and cash declined by €4 thousand to only €1 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Financing included a €343 thousand related-party loan.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Management expects fibreboard demand to remain stable and continues to invest in Nordic markets, product development and energy-efficient production.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: All HIGH importance criteria except K5 are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K5 (Real estate development details) is entirely missing, as there is no mention of the Admirali Quarter project, design works, building permits, or the preliminary sale-purchase agreement for ten properties. The remaining criteria (K1-K4, K6-K8) are covered with sufficient core meaning: revenue growth, EBITDA loss, net loss, EPS, asset/liability changes, factory shutdown impact, fibreboard segment performance, cash flow movements, boiler house investment, and personnel changes. The absence of K5, which is a HIGH importance item, prevents the summary from achieving a 'Yes' rating, but the majority of key information is present, justifying a 'Generally yes' assessment.
